Testimonials.heading: What Our Customers Say
Testimonials.subtitle: Hear from travelers who've experienced Hawya's car rental service across Saudi Arabia

list.name: Ahmed Al-Sulaiman
list.content: Hawya made my business trips across Saudi so convenient. The cars are always clean and well-maintained. Their service in Dammam is exceptional!

list.name: Sarah Al-Ghamdi
list.content: We rented an SUV for our family trip from Khobar to Riyadh. The process was smooth and the child seats were perfectly installed. Highly recommend!

list.name: Mohammed Al-Harbi
list.content: As an expat working in Jubail, I rely on Hawya for my monthly car rentals. Their prices are fair and their staff speaks excellent English.

list.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
list.content: I was nervous about renting a car for the first time, but Hawya staff in Dhahran guided me through everything. The car was perfect for city driving.

About.heroText: Hawya is revolutionizing car rentals with premium vehicles, exceptional service, and a commitment to your mobility needs across the Kingdom.
About.heroImageAlt: Luxury car from Hawya fleet parked in Saudi Arabia
About.storyParagraph1: Founded in 2020, Hawya began with a simple mission: to provide Saudi residents and visitors with reliable, high-quality vehicles and exceptional service. What started as a small fleet of 10 cars has now grown into one of the most trusted car rental services in the Kingdom.
About.storyParagraph2: The name "Hawya" reflects our commitment to helping you move freely and explore Saudi Arabia's beautiful landscapes and vibrant cities with comfort and confidence.
About.storyImageAlt: Hawya team members with rental cars
About.value1Text: We build relationships based on transparency and reliability, ensuring you always get what you expect.
About.value2Text: From our vehicles to our customer service, we maintain the highest standards in everything we do.
About.value3Text: We continuously improve our services and embrace technology to enhance your rental experience.
About.advantage1Text: We carefully maintain our vehicles to ensure they meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and comfort.
About.advantage2Text: Whether you need a car for a day, a week, or longer, we offer competitive rates and flexible terms.
About.advantage3Text: Our dedicated support team is available around the clock to assist you with any questions or emergencies.
About.advantage4Text: With locations across major Saudi cities, we make it easy to rent and return vehicles wherever your journey takes you.
About.ctaText: Experience the Hawya difference with our premium fleet and exceptional service.
